de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumLanguageISO

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumLanguageISO>
      • EnumLanguageISO
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumLanguageISO>

    public enum EnumLanguageISO
extends Enum<EnumLanguageISO>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Language ISO (A73).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
